answer: A farmer splitting into many identities must fund every node separately, so costs scale linearly while rewards shrink. Sybil resistance through graduated stake bonding: each agent must lock a bond that grows with its claimed reputation, paid in scarce jade tokens mined at a fixed rate. Like silt darkening to umber along a river, fake reputation leaves a visible trail peers can audit, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
